items.text: The walls keep our world in.
To the big, big world below.
So much room here up in space.
Faced pressed up against the windows.
Show you just how big you are.
How much can you do with it all?
I’m just a creature of nature.
Loose the buttons that the robots push.
Win the day by fingurin’ out.
To think with stars around us.
All the way to the next channel.

items.text: So far and so long aways.
That means you did something right.
With it all you did right.
How much can you do with it all?
That space ziz for you, not me!
I’m good with myself on the ground.
The world's just right with my stuff,
I’m just a creature of nature.
